note: Written from sql/11_dimension_act.sql (usp_Insights_Dimension_Act). Verified by SourceMapVerificationTests - every query must return exactly what the report's procedure returned. Overdue is a live figure: a check run later can differ slightly from the report.
setup: -- Step 1. Obligations this user is allowed to see, with the law each belongs to
--         (ComplianceInstance -> Compliance -> Act; permitted locations and categories; active; nothing deleted).
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#inst') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #inst;
SELECT s.ComplianceInstanceID, s.BranchID, s.Imprisonment, s.ActID INTO #inst
-- Step 2. Keep only obligations with at least one due date inside the report period (ComplianceScheduleOn.ScheduleOn).
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ComplianceScheduleOn cso
-- Step 3. Obligations overdue right now: past due and not closed, or never touched (ComplianceScheduleOn, ComplianceTransaction).
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#ovd') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #ovd;

checks.name: All obligations in the report
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #inst;

checks.name: Obligations linked to a law (sum of all law rows)
checks.tables: Obligations whose Compliance points to an Act.
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #inst WHERE ActID IS NOT NULL;

checks.name: Overdue obligations
checks.tables: Step 3. Live - can move between runs.
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #ovd;

checks.name: Overall overdue rate (%)
query: SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #inst) = 0 THEN 0
ELSE 100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #ovd) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #inst) END AS DECIMAL(5,1)) AS Value;

checks.name: Laws in the report
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ActID) AS Value FROM #inst WHERE ActID IS NOT NULL;

checks.name: Distinct law names
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.Name) AS Value FROM Act a WHERE a.ID IN (SELECT ActID FROM #inst);

checks.name: States with at least one law
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.State) AS Value FROM Act a WHERE a.ID IN (SELECT ActID FROM #inst) AND a.State IS NOT NULL;

checks.name: Obligations not linked to any law
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #inst WHERE ActID IS NULL;

checks.name: Share not linked to any law (%)
query: SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN ActID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) END AS DECIMAL(5,1)) AS Value FROM #inst;

checks.name: Largest regulator (ID)
query: SELECT TOP 1 a.RegulatorID AS Value FROM #inst i JOIN Act a ON a.ID = i.ActID
WHERE a.RegulatorID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a.RegulatorID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC;

checks.name: Largest regulator's share of obligations (%)
checks.tables: That regulator's obligations / all obligations x 100.
query: SELECT TOP 1 CAST(100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #inst) AS DECIMAL(5,1)) AS Value
FROM #inst i JOIN Act a ON a.ID = i.ActID
WHERE a.RegulatorID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a.RegulatorID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC;

checks.name: A law's obligations
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #inst WHERE ActID = {RowKey};

checks.name: A law's overdue obligations
checks.tables: This law's obligations that are in step 3.
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #inst i JOIN #ovd o ON o.ComplianceInstanceID = i.ComplianceInstanceID WHERE i.ActID = {RowKey};

checks.name: A law's overdue rate (%)
checks.tables: Overdue obligations / obligations x 100, for this law.
query: SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN o.ComplianceInstanceID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) END AS DECIMAL(5,1)) AS Value
FROM #inst i LEFT JOIN #ovd o ON o.ComplianceInstanceID = i.ComplianceInstanceID WHERE i.ActID = {RowKey};

checks.name: A law's obligations with a possible prison term
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #inst WHERE ActID = {RowKey} AND Imprisonment = 1;

checks.name: A law's overdue obligations with a possible prison term
checks.tables: Compliance.Imprisonment = 1 and overdue now, this law.
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #inst i JOIN #ovd o ON o.ComplianceInstanceID = i.ComplianceInstanceID
WHERE i.ActID = {RowKey} AND i.Imprisonment = 1;

checks.name: Locations where a law applies
checks.tables: Distinct CustomerBranch of this law's obligations.
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT BranchID) AS Value FROM #inst WHERE ActID = {RowKey};

checks.name: Laws at 100% overdue
checks.tables: Laws where every obligation is overdue (L3 = 100).
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM (
SELECT i.ActID FROM #inst i LEFT JOIN #ovd o ON o.ComplianceInstanceID = i.ComplianceInstanceID
WHERE i.ActID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY i.ActID
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN o.ComplianceInstanceID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = COUNT(*)) x;

checks.name: Laws with at least one possible prison term
checks.tables: Laws where L4 is more than 0.
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ActID) AS Value FROM #inst WHERE ActID IS NOT NULL AND Imprisonment = 1;

checks.name: Newer laws running above the overall overdue rate (the start-date signal)
checks.tables: Laws whose Act.StartDate is after the middle start date of the report's laws AND whose overdue rate is above A4. Laws below the 50-obligation floor are left out unless fewer than 2 laws reach it.
query: WITH r AS (SELECT i.ActID, COUNT(*) AS Instances, MAX(a.StartDate) AS StartDate,
CAST(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN o.ComplianceInstanceID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL(5,1)) AS OverduePct
FROM #inst i JOIN Act a ON a.ID = i.ActID LEFT JOIN #ovd o ON o.ComplianceInstanceID = i.ComplianceInstanceID
GROUP BY i.ActID),
t AS (SELECT CAST(100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #ovd) / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #inst), 0) AS DECIMAL(5,1)) AS TenantPct),
f AS (SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM r WHERE Instances >= 50) < 2 THEN 1 ELSE 50 END AS RankFloor),
m AS (SELECT TOP 1 CAST(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY CAST(StartDate AS FLOAT)) OVER () AS DATETIME) AS MedStart
FROM r WHERE StartDate IS NOT NULL)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM r CROSS JOIN t CROSS JOIN f CROSS JOIN m
WHERE r.Instances >= f.RankFloor AND r.StartDate > m.MedStart AND r.OverduePct > t.TenantPct;

checks.name: Overdue obligations with a possible prison term, all laws added up
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #inst i JOIN #ovd o ON o.ComplianceInstanceID = i.ComplianceInstanceID
WHERE i.ActID IS NOT NULL AND i.Imprisonment = 1;
